about_short_description.short_description: Truffle Security is an open source cybersecurity company that offers solutions for finding and remediating leaked software credentials.

product.name: TruffleHog Open Source
product.description: An open-source secrets discovery and verification tool that scans code, repositories, files, and other data sources for exposed credentials.

product.name: TruffleHog Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise secrets security platform for detecting, verifying, analyzing, monitoring, and remediating exposed non-human identities and credentials across the SDLC.

product.name: TruffleHog Analyze
product.description: A secrets analysis capability that maps exposed credentials to their associated identities, resources, permissions, and potential impact.

product.name: TruffleHog GCP Analyze
product.description: A Google Cloud-focused secrets analysis offering for assessing the resources, permissions, and risk associated with exposed GCP credentials.

product.name: TruffleHog Forager
product.description: A Truffle Security offering for searching large public datasets and other broad data sources for exposed secrets and credentials.
